reviews.t: Greasy, and poor scent, and broken containers
reviews.x: This deodorant is more like Vaseline... that is actually the most accurate way to describe this. It's exactly like rubbing slime all over yourself. And the cedar wood sent mixed with juniper does not really smell good at all. It's like a very cheap cedarwood essence. Huge cost cutting here.  Plus on top of this the actual deodorant sticks arrived All broken at the top. The caps are all fractured as if all these products took a tumble from a high shelf. Definitely doesn't seem like something whic

Loved this product until I realized that it stained all my shirts.  Depending upon the fabric, it might come out in the wash, but unfortunately the oil leaves grease marks under one's arms on shirts.  Also, it appears that regular use of this product dyed my armpit hair auburn.  I don't have auburn hair anywhere else on my body.

I have been using Schmidt’s for years.  It is a clean, natural and great smelling deodorant that works.  When I decided to drop the common-brand toxic deodorants it took a few try's to find one that kept my pits smelling good.  When I found Schmidt’s I was sold almost immediately.  All the scents are fantastic and it lasts a long time.  The big brand deodorants couldn’t keep my pits from stinking sometimes, but they never stink when I use Schmidt’s.  All you need is three swipes in your pits and

See attached pic. After using this once it gave me a very painful rash, could this be a chemical burn??? I thought I had used this product before but it was not smooth to apply but I loved the scent and had no reaction to it. This version must be a different formula because it went on very smooth but I ended up getting a very painful rash that lasted about a week.

I have used this brand and scent b4 and like it alot.  This multi pack does not seem the same. Scent is not as strong and pruduct consistency is off. Has little pockets of different consistency like bubbles in it that have not seen in it b4.  Makes wonder if these are some factory seconds sold off the purchased up an liquidated on Amazon.
If you like to smell like a freshly cleaned hamster cage, this is the product for you.

reviews.t: Smells like a cross between a Cedar closet and a woodshed
reviews.x: I have been using Schimdt's deodorant for years and love that is is all natural. This far I have enjoyed the scents. The Cedar and Juniper I am not sure if I like yet.  Pros: $18.45 for six 2.65 oz sticks of deodorant is a great price. It does work for over 24 hours like all other Schmidt's products. It is all natural (which is important to me).  Cons: The Cedar scent is a bit overwhelming. No one has complained yet, but I can smell it constantly. I smell like a cross between a Cedar closet and

The warnings from other reviews are correct. These too good to be true prices are just that. The product I purchased was nearly 2 years past expiration and the smell was horrible. These third party sellers are trying to offload expired deodorant and that does not fare well for a natural product like Schmidt’s. Don’t waste your time on this garbage, I will be returning for a refund.

I don’t know if it was a bad batch or what but the smell was really bad. It smelled like old stale motor oil or petroleum. Zero smell of Cedarwood or juniper. On top of that it has sand grittiness in it.  To be fair, I have another scent of the same brand that I love, the citrus, so buy that one instead.

reviews.t: Keeps smell away at a cost
reviews.x: It worked to keep odors away but within days my armpits became red, dry, and itchy because of the ingredients. I believe it is the baking soda that caused this. Now I cannot use it as often because of this.

This thing (Cedarwood + Juniper) SMELLS FAR WORSE THAN THE SWEAT.  Very strange , since both the other two Schmidt's : Magnesium scent and the Bergamot lime SMELL VERY GOOD, amazing and last a whole day.
Love this brand of deodorant but could NOT put  these into the Xmas stockings of our male family members.  Will get another scent instead!
They smell decent, last all day (and then some), but they have little chunks/specs that need sweat/friction to make them melt.
This purchase was a disappointment,  the smell was off  and not in a good way ; I don't know if it was an old product or what
Do not waste your money on this product. It will ruin your clothes.

reviews.t: Don’t waste your time with Lume. This Stuff ROCKS!
reviews.x: My armpits totally reject the chemicals and alcohol used in store-bought deodorants. I tried this stuff, in the charcoal version from Costco and I was amazed at how good it protected me from body odor and smelled so good. I bought this particular scent very skeptical about the juniper smell, but I have to say I love the earthy scent and it stays with me all day long.  I tried Every Man Jack and Lumi and all I have to say is that neither one is worth the powder to blow them to hell, and neither h

My wife bought this for me from Whole Foods because I like the smell of Deodore Cedar.  I used it for at least a week when I noticed I had clogged pores that had become Infected.  I went to the Doctor and they gave me a really strong antibiotic to stop the infection.  Because I had to take the antibiotics, I started getting mild symptoms of Ulcerative Colitis which eventually turned into severe Ulcerative Colitis.  My wife contacted Schmidt before I had taken the antibiotic.  They never replied

I really like this brand. I'm not sure if it's the scent, or if this bundle was sitting in the warehouse for awhile, but  it caused a rash. The deo itself was somewhat two-toned, which lead me to believe it was in the heat/warehouse too long. I know that rash is a side effect, but I usually use the charcoal and magnesium one and never had an issue. This was a good deal for 6, but I had to stop using it. Still have 3 left

reviews.t: It works!!! And I’m a man that sweats
reviews.x: I’ve never been able to wear deodorant, only antiperspirant.  This is the ONLY brand of natural deodorant I’ve tried that keeps me smelling fresh all day.  I’ve never done an intense work out with it on, but I’d be showering after anyways.  This replaced the old spice antiperspirant I relied upon for years that would sometimes ruin my shirts and still not do a good job keeping me smelling fresh for a full day.

reviews.t: Smells great, works for a long time, and no skin irritation
reviews.x: Love the smell. Keeps me smelling like the woods for at least a day if I'm sweating, and longer if I'm not.  No skin irritation whatsoever, and I have somewhat sensitive skin (at least to artificial fragrances).  It also mixes well with body chemistry for my whole family (i.e. when you start to sweat the smell doesn't change to something awful).

I love Schmidt's. However, it is expensive. So, when I came across this 6-pack, I jumped on it. Cheapest I've ever paid for Schmidt. While I've gotten this scent before, using it exclusively makes the unique scent very apparent. I often think I stink, but it's just the scent (honestly). My wife likes it, and hasn't complained about the scent.

reviews.t: Scent is truly aweful - Cedarwood + Juniper
reviews.x: I'm no stranger to either scent. I dunno what they were thinking. I grabbed a fresh one and asked a bunch of people hanging out at the house their thoughts on scent and everyone was baffled at how this made it past the corporate smell testers. I will say this, for "some reason" this was a 6-pack for $21. I dare say I've sussed out why.

I don’t even want to say how well this works bc then everyone will buy it and I won’t be able to get it but I have tried literally every deodorant on the market including mens and not one of them killed my underarm BO. This one is it! Haven’t smelled my pits since I started using it years ago. I buy these in bulk.

I like Schmidt deodorant especially the charcoal one but found it to have chunks of gravelike stuff in it that hurt to apply. This particular product is also inconsistent with some being very crumbly and mushy. It's effective at stopping odor but the lack of quality control and consistency is a deal breaker.

reviews.t: I got the same chemical burns as reported by others!
reviews.x: I was kind of shocked to see the other reviews/photos that show the same reaction that I had (yes, almost like chemical burns and blisters!!!). And I don't have any allergies to anything. This is the first time that I've ever had a reaction to any deodorant and I've been wearing deodorant for 40 years.

claims.text: Many reviewers strongly dislike the Cedarwood + Juniper scent, describing it as bad-smelling or off.
Several reviewers report skin irritation, rashes, or chemical burns from using the product.
Some reviewers say the product stains or ruins clothing.
Some reviewers suspect the product is expired, old, or a lower-quality/factory-seconds batch.
A few reviewers note gritty or chunky texture in the product.
